location_raw: Westwood, MA; Berlin, CT; Manchester, NH
description:
Eversource does not offer immigration-related sponsorship, except in rare circumstances when there is a compelling business need. Applicants who require immigration sponsorship—either now or in the future—generally should not apply. This includes, but is not limited to, direct company sponsorship, listing Eversource as the employer of record on immigration documents, or any work authorization that requires company involvement or documentation (e.g., H-1B, OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, TN, J-1, O-1, etc.).

Role and Scope of Position:
This position is responsible for the overall management of the Special Studies team within Eversource Transmission System Planning. This group identifies, scopes, and performs unique analyses that fall outside of the traditional planning paradigm. It covers the entire three-state Eversource service territory. With the monumental changes taking place in electric generation, transmission, loads, etc., this position will continuously innovate and adapt novel study approaches with the goal of more forward-looking, holistic transmission planning. Among other things, deliverables include development of plans for scenario-based transmission system expansion, resiliency, and reinforcement.

This position is also responsible for establishing goals, monitoring and reporting results, and managing budgets. Additionally, this group provides technical leadership and expertise, elicits ideas and solves complex engineering problems, and is accountable for major technical recommendations. Interaction with external and internal stakeholders is critical, including for example the Independent System Operators-NE (ISO-NE) working groups and New England Power Pool (NEPOOL) or Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) committees. Participates and understands the project economics, the ISO generation markets and the ISO generation pricing and their effects on the Eversource Transmission Business and its customers. Develops plans for solving major engineering problems and opportunities and has responsibility for interpreting, organizing, executing and coordinating assignments. Provides strategic and tactical leadership for regulatory filings of various projects. Performs analyses for operating companies as required. Manages technical projects having significant impact on the design, engineering, and operation of the transmission system. Essential Functions:

- Manages special studies for electric transmission system planning, including future grid scenarios, essential reliability services, public policy impacts, and resiliency.

- Solves complex technical problems requiring recognized expertise in electric power systems, various engineering and operating disciplines, and resultant regulatory impacts, etc., to resolve major power facilities problems.  The desired solutions should be compatible and part of the overall business unit strategy.

- Presents, directs and/or prepares corporate presentations and written comments for technical committees, and other local, state or federal regulatory proceedings.

- Manages technical projects having significant economic impact on the design, engineering, construction and operation on the Eversource transmission system.

- Formulates Eversource technical positions and recommends company policies and standards on various issues within expertise.

- Interfaces with federal, state and local organizations external to Eversource on behalf of or as a representative of Eversource.

- Assimilates transmission business knowledge (FERC/State regulatory decisions, desires, etc.) in order to derive future Transmission Plans and Needs.  Provides appropriate input into the Eversource transmission strategy.

- Serves on various Eversource internal committees and task forces to provide information and recommendations to Eversource senior management.

- Represents Eversource with respect to assigned area of transmission responsibilities on various industry and professional society committees and working groups.

- Establishes and monitors system network capabilities, utilization and performance measures.

- Collaborates with other departments/engineers on design of system projects.

- Develops and implements best practices to achieve efficient and effective special study planning activities.

- Manages the team by establishing and monitoring area goals, policies, plans, programs, performance objectives and budget.

- Analyzes and recommends resource levels to plan, develop and implement programs and policies.

- Establishes operational and financial objectives and aligns with department goals.

- Oversees the management and development of area staff.  Assesses the need for and oversees implementation of programs to ensure employees possess technical, interpersonal and organizational skills required to support operating plans.  Supervises, selects, coaches and develops area staff.

Technical Knowledge/Skills:

- Requires thorough knowledge and experience in electric transmission planning, system analysis computer applications and modeling, operations support, budgeting, project analysis, working cross-functionally and communicating.

- Demonstrated leadership in strategic planning.

- Thorough knowledge of transmission power system protection and control systems

Education:

- Requires a Bachelor of Science Degree in Engineering.  Advanced degree preferred.

Experiences:

- Ten (10) years in transmission system planning, engineering or related operations management experience including supervisory experience.

- Professional Engineer’s License preferred.

Role and Scope of Position:
Performs as project leader and/or carries out assignments requiring mastery of subject matter, with
extensive experience associated with planning distribution substation facilities, distribution lines and underground network systems in an electric power system. Exhibits strong technical skills on the design of the electric power system. Represents the company regarding matters in distribution planning at the state public utility commissions and various state and regional entities. Essential Functions:

- Develop medium (2-5 year) and long (5+ year) range distribution plans involving load relief, capacity, asset related issues, and large DER integration.

- Propose new distribution substation and associated OH and UG feeders.

- Provides leadership in coordinating multiple cross-functional groups, and positive guidance for engineers.

- Presents recommendations and/or results to all levels of management as appropriate.

- Represents the department and the company on various committees.

- Recommends the development and/or changes as appropriate of criteria and standards for distribution planning.

- Hands-on experience running and executing electrical simulations in Synergi Electric, CYME or equivalent power system simulation programs.

- Knowledge of new technologies including but not limited to photovoltaic solar, electric vehicles, and battery storage.

- Knowledge of the techniques for planning the expansion of distribution lines and distribution substation facilities.

- Advanced knowledge of electrical theory as applied to planning an electric power supply system.

- Advanced knowledge of distribution line design and operating practices.

- Knowledge of National, State and other planning standards.

- Good written and oral communication skills, including formal presentation.

- Excellent teamwork skills.

- Effective interpersonal skills, ability to develop strategic partnerships.

- Ability to achieve desired results by setting high standards for self and others and accepts responsibility for outcomes.

Education:

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering required, Electric Power Systems preferred

- Advanced degree preferred

- Minimum of five (5) years related experience in planning, design, and operations related to distribution line, distribution substation facilities, and underground network systems with a thorough knowledge of power system planning.

Role and Scope of Position:
Associate Engineer in Transmission System Planning assists in transmission system studies and project development by carrying out assignments associated with the modeling and development of Eversource's transmission system. The role provides support for power system study model development and maintenance and performs technical analysis under guidance. Typical reliability studies include analyses of power flow, stability, electromagnetic transient, and short circuit. *Expected start date, Spring 2027

Transmission System Planning team has the task of making sure that Eversource’s future bulk power system serves our customers safely and reliably and meets applicable reliability National and local State Interconnection Standards. The group must look ahead between near- and long-term planning horizon into the future to determine what upgrades are needed in order for the transmission and distribution system to comply with the local State regulatory requirements as well as complying with National and Regional Standards.

The Transmission System Planning, Associate Engineer role supports the development and analysis of electric transmission system models and assists in evaluating system performance under various operating conditions. This role is designed for recent graduates with foundational knowledge in power systems and electrical engineering who are eager to gain hands-on experience in utility planning and reliability studies.

- Supports development and maintenance of the system models for transmission studies under guidance of more senior Engineers.  This includes:

- Collection and review of the forecast loads to be included in the model

- Collection, modification, and review of a variety of electric system parameters including: equipment ratings, impedances, contingency sets, protection and control parameters, as well as system topology

- Collection, modification, and review of electric system modeling for steady state, stability, short circuit, and EMT analyses

- Assists with transmission planning studies in the entire Eversource service territories.  This includes:

- Preparation of study scopes based on determined study assumptions

- Verification of technical information and models according to modeling processes

- Application of corporate planning standards in conjunction with any other applicable NERC, NPCC, and ISO-NE reliability standards and criteria

- Supporting solutions development to mitigate identified significant adverse impacts by testing solution alternatives as directed

- Providing support to more senior Engineers for interfacing with various ISO-NE staff, DER and Distribution System Planning, line and substation engineering, asset management, siting, environmental and permitting, operations, etc. for the determination of system impacts and proposed solutions

- Documentation of study results in study reports

- Assisting Senior Engineers for providing study updates and presenting study results to regulatory agencies, customers, and affected parties

- Other supporting tasks include:

- Study process automation for routines with transmission analysis tools.

- Clearly and effectively communicates the results of analyses both verbally and in writing

- Assists with development of training modules
